opening.argument: The video presents a lyrical song tied to the film SANJU, with a romantic fictional premise centered on a character’s imagined quest for love. Its title identifies the lyrical format and associated film and artists, while the description explains that it depicts “Sanju’s quest for love as he lets his imagination run wild.” The supplied frames reinforce that presentation through film-style scenes, overlaid lyric text, and the T-Series film-poster branding. The references to music services, setting the song as a caller tune, and subscribing to the channel are ordinary ways to access the music or engage with its distributor. They do not, on the stated evidence, constitute deceptive solicitation or a harmful transaction.
